shellBehavior: sudo -u root runs npm install evil-pkg as root. The parser skips the wrapper name 'sudo' but then treats the wrapper's own option '-u' as the command position and stops, missing the install.
note: findCommandTokenIndex() skips wrapper NAMES but has no model of wrapper OPTION flags (sudo -u/-E/-H, env -i/-C/-u, command -p, time -p). Each wrapper has different flag/value semantics, so a correct skip is non-trivial and is deferred.
